### How to work in this repo

- **Trust the index.** `verified: true` and `_meta.complete` mean the bytes were checked against the live tree, so never re-read them. Re-read only what `bounds: "approximate"` or `_meta.stale_warning` names. `confidence` rates the prose, not the evidence: on `low` read the `fallback_targets` or `best_guesses` the reply names, and run `repowise update` and ask again if `_meta.hint` says the index is behind HEAD. `index_behind: true` alone is informational.
- **A zero carries its basis.** An empty `callers`/`callees`/`used_by` comes with a `*_basis` saying how much of that language's calls the graph resolved, so read it before concluding nothing calls a symbol. `_meta.scope_hint` names the areas the answer did not touch.
- **Pre-edit, not instead-of-edit.** These tools decide *which* files to read and edit. Reading a file before you edit it is correct and expected.
- **Noisy commands** (tests, builds, `git log`/`diff`, searches, listings): prefer `repowise distill <cmd>`, the same command with its exit code preserved and errors-first output. A `[repowise#<ref>: N lines omitted]` marker is recoverable via `repowise expand <ref>` (add `-q <regex>` to filter); never re-run the command to see omitted output.
- **Recording a decision** you had to reason out: `repowise decision add --title T --decision D` records it without prompting and prints the id (`--format json` to parse it back). It lands `proposed`, for a person to confirm.

### Tools

| Tool | When and why |
|------|--------------|
| `get_answer(question)` | First call for any how/where/why question. Cite `confidence: "high"` or `grounding: "extracted"` directly; `degraded` means judge by `retrieval_quality`. `symbol_bodies` has live bodies. |
| `get_context(targets=[...])` | Triage card for files/modules/symbols: docs, signatures, hotspot, fix history. No source bytes — `include=["skeleton"]` for the whole file verified, `["callers"|"decisions"]` for depth. Batch targets. |
| `get_symbol(id, depth?)` | **Follow-up, not an entry point** — one verified body for an id a prior response named (`path.py::Name`, `path.py:140-180`, `repowise#<hex>`). Never walk a file symbol by symbol; Read it. |
| `search_codebase(query)` | Hybrid search, auto-routed by query shape; force with `mode=symbol|path|concept|hybrid`. A hit whose `sources` are `[fts]` only has no semantic agreement, so verify it. |
| `get_why(query, targets?)` | Why the code is shaped this way: decision records, git archaeology, rationale comments. Call before a refactor or a pattern divergence. |
| `get_risk(targets, changed_files?, include?)` | File history and structural reach. PR mode leads with `directive`; its 0-10 structural heuristic is uncalibrated, not a probability. Read typed test recommendations and coverage state first. |
| `get_change_risk(revspec?, extensions?, exclude_patterns?)` | Deterministic live-diff review signal for a commit or range. Lead with benchmarked percentile/classification; the 0-10 diff-shape score is supporting, not a probability. `get_risk` scores paths. |
| `get_health(targets?, include?)` | Defect / maintainability / performance scores and findings, plus documentation the code no longer supports. Self-check the files you touched before finishing. |
| `get_dead_code(tier?, min_confidence?, safe_only?)` | Confidence-tiered unreachable files / unused exports / zombie packages. For cleanup sweeps, not targeted fixes. |
| `get_overview()` | Architecture map. Call once, first, in an unfamiliar repo; skip it after that. |

### Architecture
kiosk-app -> B2B wholesale management & debt reconciliation system: takes customers (restaurant chains), price lists & orders -> Hono API + Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL 16 -> invoices, debt tracking, dashboards & PDF/Excel reports -> served to React 19 SPA. Food-distribution ops tool; production-ready startup MVP. Monorepo, 3 tiers, TypeScript throughout. Request path: feature module -> TanStack Query hook -> typed api-client (cookie session) -> Hono route -> Drizzle -> PostgreSQL; Redis for cache.

### Key modules
- `backend/src` — HTTP API server code of the app — backend/src owns entry points (app.ts, server.ts), validated config + DB/Redis clients, shared lib, &…
- `frontend/src` — Frontend bootstrap + static asset shelf: main.tsx wires providers, error boundary, auth state & TanStack Router route tree into the app…
- `frontend/src/features` — Heads frontend/src/features: every app screen lives here as one self-contained slice per domain — auth (sign-in & companies), customers…
- `frontend/src/components/base` — Shared pattern: leaf components extend common prop bases
- `frontend/src/types` — Shared type & utility substrate for the frontend: frontend/src/types declares every backend-facing entity shape — single source of truth…
- `frontend/src/components/foundations/payment-icons` — Payment brand icons supply the 57-brand payment mark set (AffirmIcon, AfterpayIcon, AlipayIcon, AmazonIcon, AmexIcon, ApplePayIcon, …)…
- `frontend/src/lib` — Low-level client plumbing in frontend/src/lib: authenticated Axios transport (api-client.ts) + server-error decoding…
- `frontend/src/components/application` — Plus 4 more dirs not enumerated here
- `backend` — Boots + configures the Hono backend: backend/src/app.ts factory assembles middleware & all module routes, backend/src/server.ts listens on…
- `backend/src/modules` — Twelve feature modules under backend/src/modules — auth + 11 domain resources (orders, invoices, reports, price-lists, units, companies…

## UI/UX work — UntitledUI PRO + Tailkit MCP

> **START HERE for any UI/UX task in this repo — do not hand-write markup first.**
> Load the **`uui`** skill (UntitledUI React PRO). It is installed and its description already
> matches dashboards, settings/auth/application UI, page templates, redesigns and component
> replacement. Then apply the project rules below, which the skill cannot know.
>
> Order of operations for a UI/UX problem:
> 1. Ask the **UntitledUI MCP** what already exists / what to install.
> 2. Check `src/components/{base,application,foundations}` — much of it is already there.
> 3. Only then write code. Never hand-roll a component the catalog already ships.

**This frontend is a native UntitledUI PRO project.** It was scaffolded from UntitledUI page
templates through that MCP, and every dependency those templates declare is already installed
(`react-aria-components@1.21.1`, `react-aria@3.52.1`, `@untitledui/icons@0.0.23`). Use the MCPs
for UI work — do not hand-roll components that already exist on disk.

### Repo overrides — these beat any generic skill

The `tailkit-ui` skill is installed and also triggers on this work. Where it disagrees with the
list below, **this repo wins**:

| Generic skill says | This repo |
|---|---|
| `npx shadcn@latest` to install components | **Do not.** That installs Radix primitives, which conflict with the React Aria stack. Use `npx untitledui@latest` (below). |
| lucide icons | **`@untitledui/icons` only.** Resolve names via the MCP's `search_icons`. |
| CSS-var / shadcn colour vars | Semantic tokens from `src/styles/theme.css` (`text-primary`, `bg-success-primary`, `border-primary`, …) |
| 44px mobile touch targets | **30/32/36px** (`h-7.5`/`h-8`/`h-9`) — the dense 11/12px contract |
| tailwind default type scale | Everything ≥ `text-xl` is banned; scale is 11px/12px only |
| dark mode variants | Light-only. No `dark:` anywhere. |

### Which MCP for which task

| Need | Use | Why |
|---|---|---|
| A component (dialog, select, combobox, table part…) | **UntitledUI** `get_component` / `get_component_bundle` | Emits real React Aria code. Drops in with **zero translation** — deps already match. |
| A full page/section layout | **UntitledUI** `get_page_templates` → `get_page_template_files` | 38 PRO templates; uses the same components already installed here. |
| An exact icon | **UntitledUI** `search_icons` | Returns the correct PascalCase import. Never guess icon names. |
| Page composition ideas | **Tailkit** `get_component_suggestions` | Strong page-type guidance for `dashboard`, `settings_page`, `auth_page`. |
| A layout to imitate | **Tailkit** `get_component_code` | **Read for arrangement only.** Its markup is not shippable — see the translation table. |

UntitledUI is the engine (production code, zero translation). Tailkit is the layout lens.

### Installing an UntitledUI component

`frontend/components.json` is configured with this project's real aliases — notably
`utils: "@/utils/cx"` (exports `cx` + `sortCx`) and `iconLibrary: "@untitledui/icons"`.
Do not copy `templates/components.json`; it is wrong here (lucide, `@/lib/utils`).

```bash
cd frontend
# a single component
npx untitledui@latest add <component> --yes --license $UNTITLEDUI_KEY
# several at once
npx untitledui@latest add button avatar badges --yes --license $UNTITLEDUI_KEY
# a full page template (note: the verb is `example`, not `add`)
npx untitledui@latest example dashboards-01/11 --yes --license $UNTITLEDUI_KEY
```

**Known CLI quirk:** the CLI shells out to `npm install` for component deps, which fails on
this pnpm workspace with `EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL … workspace:*`. The component file still installs
correctly. The deps it wants are already present at satisfying versions, so this is cosmetic —
but if a component genuinely misses a dep, add it with `pnpm add` rather than fighting the CLI.

**Vendor dirs are read-only.** `src/components/{base,application,foundations,shared-assets}` are
CLI-installed third-party code, exempt from lint and the token guard. If a component needs
app-specific behaviour, wrap or compose it in `src/features/**` — do not edit in place, or the
next `untitledui add` will silently clobber your change.

### Translating Tailkit output — required before it lands

Tailkit emits raw mockup JSX. It **cannot** be pasted in. Translate it:

*Colour* — the app uses the **shim vocabulary** (`text-primary`, `border-primary`, `bg-primary`),
which resolves through `untitledui.css`'s alias layer to the `--color-*` tokens. `fg-*` classes
are direct theme keys and are valid, but they are **not** the house convention — the exception is
the status family (`text-fg-success`, `text-fg-warning`, `text-fg-error`, `text-fg-brand`), which
belongs to a different scale and is correct as written.

| Tailkit emits | Use |
|---|---|
| `bg-white`, `bg-primary` | `bg-primary` |
| `bg-gray-50/100`, `bg-secondary-50` | `bg-secondary` |
| `border-gray-200`, `border-secondary-100` | `border-primary` (default edge) / `border-secondary` (row dividers) |
| `text-gray-900/800` | `text-primary` |
| `text-gray-600/700`, `text-secondary-700` | `text-secondary` |
| `text-gray-500` (muted) | `text-tertiary` body-muted · `text-quaternary` faintest tier |
| primary action | `bg-brand-primary`, `text-brand-primary` |
| success / paid | `bg-success-primary` (soft `/10`), `text-success-primary` |
| warning / debt outstanding | `bg-warning-primary` (soft `/10`), `text-warning-primary` |
| error / unpaid | `bg-error-primary` (soft `/10`), `text-error-primary` |

> Note the two scales: `--color-text-quaternary` is neutral-500 but `--color-fg-quaternary` is
> neutral-400. Prefer the `text-*` form for the faintest tier so it matches the other muted text.

*Dark mode* — delete every `dark:*`. The app is light-only by contract.
*Type* — `text-xl` and up are banned; the scale is `text-xs` (11px) and `text-sm`/`md`/`lg` (12px).
*Density* — controls are `h-7.5`/`h-8`/`h-9` (30/32/36px); Tailkit's `py-2`/`py-3` are too tall.
*Icons* — `<svg className="hi-micro hi-arrow-right">` → `import { ArrowRight } from "@untitledui/icons";`
(resolve every name through the MCP's `search_icons`).

*Interactivity* — replace raw elements with the React Aria base primitives already on disk:

| Tailkit raw | Use |
|---|---|
| `<button>` | `Button` — `@/components/base/buttons/button` |
| `<a href="#">` as a button | `Button` link/render prop, or `Link` from the same module |
| `<input>` | `Input` — `@/components/base/input/input` |
| `<select>` | `Select` — `@/components/base/select/select` |
| checkbox | `Checkbox` — `@/components/base/checkbox/checkbox` |
| `<table>` | `src/components/data-table` |
| modal / dropdown | `application/modals/modal`, `base/dropdown/dropdown` |

### Landing rule + the gate

- **UntitledUI vendor code** → `src/components/{base,application,foundations,shared-assets}`.
- **Tailkit-derived composition** → `src/features/**` only. Never into a vendor dir — those are
  guard-exempt, so a mis-translated paste there would escape detection.

**`pnpm lint:tokens` must exit 0** for any UI change. It rejects palette-numbered colours,
`dark:` variants, `text-xl`+, and Heroicons CSS. `src/styles/contrast.test.ts` additionally
enforces WCAG contrast — both guards exist because `theme.css` encodes money state
(paid / due / overdue) as colour, and the brand hue is held away from the status family on
purpose. Do not move the brand ramp back into hues 120–180 without re-checking that separation.
